No updates on delivery in the app. It’s now 3 months since my order and I have heard nothing. No reply to emails from the seller.

reviews.title: Not Accurate (free version)
reviews.text: This app is simply not useful for UPS. The estimated delivery info does not update as frequently as UPS, so it’s been showing me out of date information for packages shipped by UPS from multiple retailers (Target, Old Navy, Bath and Body Works). There are pop-up ads for other products and the paid version of the app that make it cumbersome to find my package info. What the app does do decently is import tracking numbers from different orders and carriers so you can track them all in one place.

reviews.title: $9.99 per month - crazy
reviews.text: I tried this app to track a package, let me use it for about 6 hours for free, then made me do the “free” 7 day trial which would auto renew for $9.99 per WEEK!!  Wouldn’t let me view anything unless i accepted that, so I deleted the app.  It also didn’t seem to correctly track my package, it was moving while the app showed it in one place. … so seemed to have its issues on top of the cost.

reviews.title: Very poor service
reviews.text: I ordered an item over 6 weeks ago and when I subscribed to the tracking it uses yahoo that I no longer use. As a result I cannot see any notifications about my package and I have now been charged for a service that does nothing.  I do not recommend using this feature.  I should have known this purchase was too good to be true.  I had shopped QVC many times in the past but never again.

reviews.title: Money grabbers
reviews.text: Downloaded this as a website I bought something from suggested it. Got the trial and forgot to cancel it (my fault) Charged me £10 A WEEK!! Do they hire someone to personally follow my package to my house or something? Absolutely absurd to charge that much.

reviews.title: Total scam charged without free trial
reviews.text: Don’t be fooled!  I was charged from day one.  Never received the 7 free days trial.  I tried 3 times to request a refund and was denied every time.  I wouldn’t chance giving this company your credit card info because they will rip you off.  I’m a 70 year old widow, just trying to keep track of some packages I ordered.  Never again will I give Apple my info to use for subscriptions.
